user_directions.exact_text: Have you tried taking going through the whole automated system(stopping before work node creation) and seeing if your solution works?  You wouldn't process all of the plans, but pick one of the larger plan docs to do as a test.  This would be sandboxed.  The have all of the 12 models run through it twice.  Start with ox-alpha-free, max and cursor/default, effort auto.

Keep in mind, the harness the ai agent is using will change responses slightly, so running natively in Puppet Master, once built, will give a slightly different prose response.  So the only option is likely normalizing.
use GLM‑5.3‑Flash/max, dont go through all kinds of processes because of that mistake, just run it again with max.
